title: Alternating sum over a Boolean interval
statement: Let $A$ and $S$ be finite subsets of a type with decidable equality, and suppose $A\subseteq S$. Then the sum over all subsets $J$ of $S$ that contain $A$ of $(-1)^{|S|-|J|}$ is $1$ if $A=S$ and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ and $S$ are finite subsets of a type with decidable equality
